nodes.description: Private address _creator of Permissions; hardcoded privileged account used by onlyCreator and givePermissions.
Private address _uniswap; privileged router address allowed to trigger givePermissions in transferFrom.
Mapping address=>bool _permitted; whitelist checked by the onlyPermitted modifier.
Mapping address=>uint256 _balances; token balances mutated by _transfer.
Nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender]; allowances mutated by _approve and consumed by transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.
Token name set once in the ERC20 constructor (Cor3Base).
Token symbol set once in the ERC20 constructor (Cbase).
Token decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
Total supply minted to the creator in the constructor.
Permissions constructor: sets _creator, _uniswap and grants them permissions in _permitted.
Public view getter returning _creator.
Public view getter returning _uniswap.
Internal privileged function whitelisting an address; requires _msgSender() to be _creator or _uniswap.
Modifier onlyCreator: requires _msgSender() == _creator, guards approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
Modifier onlyPermitted: requires _permitted[_msgSender()], guards transfer.
ERC20 constructor: sets metadata, total supply and mints all tokens to creator().
Public transfer guarded by onlyPermitted; moves tokens and grants permissions to recipient when caller is creator.
Public transferFrom; no allowance check beyond SafeMath sub, and grants permissions to recipient when caller is uniswap.
Public approve guarded by onlyCreator; sets allowance of spender for the caller.
Internal _transfer: subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance with SafeMath, emits Transfer.
Internal _approve: writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Public increaseAllowance guarded by onlyCreator; adds to the caller's allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance guarded by onlyCreator; subtracts from the caller's allowance.
Public view balanceOf reading _balances.
Public view totalSupply returning _totalSupply.
Public view allowance reading _allowances[owner][spender].
Address.sendValue: sends ETH through a low-level call to an arbitrary recipient after a balance check.
Address._functionCallWithValue: low-level call with value to a target with arbitrary data, bubbles revert reason.
Address.functionCallWithValue: balance check then delegates to _functionCallWithValue.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used for balance/allowance credit.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used for balance and allowance debit.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication (unused by ERC20 logic).
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for permission checks and allowance ownership.
Low-level value call recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue; external interaction point.
Low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue; external interaction point.
Balance debit _balances[sender].sub(amount) in _transfer; arithmetic mutation of _balances.
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender; source of the caller identity used by all permission logic.
Public view name returning _name.
Public view symbol returning _symbol.
Public view decimals returning _decimals.
Parameter who of givePermissions; address being whitelisted.
Parameter recipient of ERC20.transfer.
Parameter amount of ERC20.transfer.
Parameter sender of ERC20.transferFrom; account debited.
Parameter recipient of ERC20.transferFrom.
Parameter amount of ERC20.transferFrom; also subtracted from the allowance.
Parameter spender of ERC20.approve.
Parameter amount of ERC20.approve.
Parameter spender of increaseAllowance.
Parameter addedValue of increaseAllowance.
Parameter spender of decreaseAllowance.
Parameter subtractedValue of decreaseAllowance.
Parameter account of balanceOf.
Parameter owner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Local variable c holding the sum inside SafeMath.add.
Parameter recipient (payable) of Address.sendValue; callee of the low-level value call.
Parameter amount of Address.sendValue; ETH value forwarded.
Parameter target of Address._functionCallWithValue; arbitrary external callee.
Parameter data of Address._functionCallWithValue; attacker-influenced calldata.
Parameter weiValue of Address._functionCallWithValue; ETH value forwarded.
Local variables success and returndata of Address._functionCallWithValue.
Parameter sender of internal _transfer.
Parameter recipient of internal _transfer.
Parameter amount of internal _transfer; value used in balance arithmetic.
Parameter owner of internal _approve.
Parameter spender of internal _approve.
Parameter amount of internal _approve; value written to _allowances.
Allowance debit _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount) inside transferFrom.
Allowance debit _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].sub(subtractedValue) inside decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: givePermissions decides privilege from msg.sender compared against _creator/_uniswap.
onlyCreator compares msg.sender with _creator to gate approve/increase/decreaseAllowance.
onlyPermitted uses msg.sender as the key into the _permitted whitelist.
transfer derives the caller identity from _msgSender() for balance debit and permission grant.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance consumption and as privilege check.
onlyCreator reads the privileged _creator state variable.
givePermissions reads _creator to authorize whitelisting.
givePermissions reads _uniswap to authorize whitelisting.
onlyPermitted reads the _permitted whitelist mapped from the caller.
givePermissions writes true into _permitted for the target address.
creator() returns the _creator state variable.
uniswap() returns the _uniswap state variable.
Permissions constructor assigns the hardcoded privileged _creator.
Permissions constructor assigns the hardcoded _uniswap address.
Permissions constructor pre-whitelists _creator and _uniswap.
ERC20 constructor sets the token name.
ERC20 constructor sets the token symbol.
ERC20 constructor sets decimals to 18.
ERC20 constructor sets the total supply.
ERC20 constructor mints the whole supply to creator().
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf() reads _balances for the queried account.
allowance() reads _allowances[owner][spender].
_transfer writes updated values into _balances, mutating token state after the debit.
_approve writes the new value into _allowances.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, the origin of all caller-derived values.
The who parameter of givePermissions flows into the _permitted write.
recipient parameter of transfer flows into _transfer and possibly givePermissions.
amount parameter of transfer flows into balance arithmetic.
sender parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer as the debited account.
recipient parameter of transferFrom flows into _transfer and givePermissions.
amount parameter of transferFrom flows into balance and allowance arithmetic.
spender parameter of approve flows into _approve.
amount parameter of approve is written into _allowances.
spender parameter of increaseAllowance flows into _approve.
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance is added to the allowance.
spender parameter of decreaseAllowance flows into _approve.
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance is subtracted from the allowance.
account parameter of balanceOf keys into _balances.
owner parameter of allowance keys into _allowances.
spender parameter of allowance keys into _allowances.
Local sum c in SafeMath.add is the checked addition result returned to callers.
sender parameter of _transfer determines which balance is debited.
recipient parameter of _transfer determines which balance is credited.
amount parameter of _transfer is used in the SafeMath debit/credit.
owner parameter of _approve keys into _allowances.
spender parameter of _approve keys into _allowances.
amount parameter of _approve is stored in _allowances.
recipient parameter of sendValue is the arbitrary callee of the value transfer.
amount parameter of sendValue is forwarded as msg.value of the low-level call.
target parameter of _functionCallWithValue is the arbitrary callee contract.
data parameter of _functionCallWithValue is the attacker-controlled calldata.
weiValue parameter of _functionCallWithValue is the forwarded ETH value.
Local success/returndata hold the external call outcome and bubbled revert data.
_balances[sender] value is read and reduced by the unsafe subtraction.
amount parameter is the operand of the balance subtraction.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is read and reduced by the unsafe subtraction.
amount operand of the allowance subtraction inside transferFrom.
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] is read and reduced by the unsafe subtraction.
subtractedValue operand of the allowance subtraction inside decreaseAllowance.
transfer invokes internal _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom invokes internal _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom invokes internal _approve to reduce the allowance.
transfer calls givePermissions(recipient) when the caller is creator, silently expanding the whitelist.
transferFrom calls givePermissions(recipient) when the caller is uniswap, silently expanding the whitelist.
approve invokes internal _approve.
increaseAllowance invokes internal _approve.
decreaseAllowance invokes internal _approve.
transfer is guarded by the onlyPermitted modifier.
approve is guarded by the onlyCreator modifier.
increaseAllowance is guarded by the onlyCreator modifier.
decreaseAllowance is guarded by the onlyCreator modifier.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance debit.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
sendValue executes the low-level value call node, transferring control to an arbitrary recipient.
_functionCallWithValue executes the low-level call node with attacker-supplied target and data.
functionCallWithValue delegates to _functionCallWithValue after the balance check.
_transfer performs the balance subtraction unsafe operation.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
decreaseAllowance performs the allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
The low-level value call hands control to an external recipient that may reenter balance-moving logic before state is settled.
The low-level call with arbitrary data may reenter the contract's balance transfer path while state is mid-update.

normalization_plan.reason: The who parameter only exists to be written into _permitted by givePermissions; merge it into the owning function node.
recipient is a transient argument of ERC20.transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
amount is only meaningful inside ERC20.transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
sender argument of transferFrom; collapse into the transferFrom function node.
recipient argument of transferFrom; collapse into the transferFrom function node.
amount argument of transferFrom also feeds the allowance debit; collapse into the transferFrom function node.
spender argument of approve; collapse into the approve function node.
amount argument of approve; collapse into the approve function node.
spender argument of increaseAllowance; collapse into the increaseAllowance function node.
addedValue argument of increaseAllowance; collapse into the increaseAllowance function node.
spender argument of decreaseAllowance; collapse into the decreaseAllowance function node.
subtractedValue feeds the allowance subtraction unsafe operation; collapse into the decreaseAllowance function node.
account is the only argument of the balanceOf view; fold it into the function node.
owner argument of the allowance view; fold it into the function node.
spender argument of the allowance view; fold it into the function node.
Local c is the intermediate sum of SafeMath.add; merge it into the add function node.
recipient is the callee of the low-level value call; merge it into the unsafe call operation node.
amount is the value forwarded by the low-level call; merge it into the unsafe call operation node.
target is the arbitrary callee of the low-level call; merge it into the unsafe call operation node.
data is the attacker-influenced calldata of the low-level call; merge it into the unsafe call operation node.
weiValue is the ETH forwarded by the low-level call; merge it into the unsafe call operation node.
success/returndata are transient results of the call wrapper; merge them into the wrapping function node.
sender argument of internal _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
recipient argument of internal _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
amount is the operand of the balance subtraction; merge it into that unsafe arithmetic operation node.
owner argument of internal _approve; fold it into the _approve function node.
spender argument of internal _approve; fold it into the _approve function node.
amount argument written to _allowances by _approve; fold it into the _approve function node.
